summary: Defines an SMTP extension that lets a sender ask for delivery status notifications under chosen conditions. The sender can say whether the original message should be returned and can attach identifying information to help match a report to a message. It was replaced by RFC 3461.

eli5.summary: When you mail a package, you can ask the post office to send back a note saying it arrived or got lost. This lets email senders ask for that kind of note.

questions: how to request delivery receipts in smtp
what is a delivery status notification
